title: createAgentSession construction
claims: SDK constructs session resources, restores branch context, and returns the AgentSession after configuring the agent stream and hooks.
notes: Selected pinned source lines inspected; no package installation or runtime execution.

title: Tool hooks and nested dispatch
claims: Session before/after hooks dispatch tool events; nested executeTool calls use the same hooks with a parent call ID.
notes: Source order is observed; fail-closed end-to-end behavior remains a fixture target.

title: Tool call, result, and user shell events
claims: tool_call returns on a block and propagates handler errors; tool_result catches handler errors and continues; user_bash propagates errors.
notes: These three event paths have different failure semantics.

title: Tool event results
claims: A pre-call handler can block; post-call handlers can replace content, details, structured content, error flag, and usage.
notes: The declarations do not establish OS isolation or persistence durability.

title: Bounded nested call summaries
claims: Parent result nestedCalls is bounded and can mark the record incomplete when arguments or calls are omitted.
notes: Not an authoritative effect ledger; upstream nested-call tests were inspected but not run.

title: Active branch traversal
claims: getBranch walks entries from current leaf to root; getLeafId and getSessionId expose distinct IDs; there is no observed upstream branchId field.
notes: New session, in-file branch and file fork were separately inspected; Splyce branchAnchor is proposed.

title: Compaction path and retained tail
claims: Compaction prepares a model-facing summary from a selected session path and retained tail.
notes: Does not prove receipt retention or crash recovery.

title: MCP tool registration and execution recheck
claims: Discovered MCP tools become Pi tools; execution rechecks server enablement and tool availability.
notes: No actual MCP server was connected in this audit.

title: MCP reconnect and retry boundary
claims: Transient HTTP retries are restricted to read-only requests; ordinary tool calls are not retried on that path because effects may have occurred.
notes: Session-expired handling is a separate branch; no exactly-once claim.

title: Headless extension binding and disposal
claims: Print and JSON modes bind extensions before prompts and dispose their runtime on normal or signal shutdown.
notes: No hard-crash cleanup or approval parity was demonstrated.

title: Interactive user shell interception
claims: Interactive user shell commands emit user_bash and stop local execution when its handler throws.
notes: This path does not use ordinary tool_call; independent enforcement fixture required.
